## Problem

Describe the observed behavior and expected result. The project currently contains planning/scaffolding only; distinguish a plan/documentation issue from an implemented behavior.

## Reproduction and environment

Include the affected file or revision, relevant host/panel versions, OS/architecture, configuration/scenario, and minimal reproduction steps. Remove private data.

## Evidence

Include relevant sanitized output. Distinguish source inference, emulator execution, host/panel integration, and Pi qualification. Report security concerns privately as described in [security reporting](../../SECURITY.md).
